crossRefs.note: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.
Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.
I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies…
Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out. Yes, a whirling storm: It will burst on the head of the wicked.
“ ‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing…
The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it fell—and great was its fall.”
He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.
that there came a messenger to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,
So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.
So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that…
Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him in the earth, a blameless and…
Although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’
Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents; but, that the works of God might be revealed in him.
But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
